player_prompt.intro:
I Player {player_id} i ni. I 15-Puzzle game khelh mek a ni.
He game thil tum ber chu, 1 atanga 15 inkar number tile te chu ascendin order-a rem tur a ni, empty space chu bottom-right corner-ah dah tur a ni.
Move pakhat siam turin, double underscore (e.g. __) in represent empty space a ni, a hnuaia tile chu a chungah siam turin, a chung a tile chu a hnuai ah siam turin, a kawtah tile chu a veilam ah siam turin, a veilam a tile chu a kawtah siam turin, hei hi a hnuaia command zinga pakhat hmangin siam tur a ni:
- 'up': Empty space chung a tile kawt a siam tur.
- 'down': Empty space hnuai a tile chung a siam tur.
- 'left': Empty space veilam a tile kawt a siam tur.
- 'right': Empty space kawtah a tile veilam a siam tur.
I move thehluh turin, direction (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', or 'right') chu square brackets a dah tur, e.g. [up].
Current board layout chu a hnuai a en theih a ni, hei hi puzzle chinfel tur a hman tur a ni.

invalid_move.illegal_move: Hnawhchhuah diklo. Tile hi a hmingah tihkhawt theih a ni lo va.

outcome.win: Lawmthu sawi ang che! Player {player_id} chuan 15-Puzzle chu a solve hlawhtling ta.
